ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level high-contrast distribution with approximately 65% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels and 35% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels visible on the ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Bilateral asymmetry. The right lobe features a concentrated high-intensity (white) patch at the distal tip containing small, circular low-intensity (dark) focal points. The left lobe displays a broader high-intensity distribution characterized by integrated linear low-intensity streaks.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 48 degrees; the absolute vertex is obscured by water-surface pixel noise.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous jagged boundary across both lobes. The right lobe displays larger-amplitude irregularities (notches), particularly one significant indentation on the upper distal edge. The left lobe displays higher-frequency, lower-amplitude serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Both lobes exhibit an upward convex sweep trajectory moving distally from the midline to the fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast circular white pixel clusters located within the central low-intensity region, notably three distinct spots adjacent to the right side of the median notch.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Series of dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions traversing the high-intensity white field of the distal left lobe region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep, irregular secondary notch on the distal trailing edge of the right lobe; high-texture, dark clusters at the extreme tips of both lobes indicative of external colonization.
